# Upstream trademark policy

BMad, BMad Method, BMad Core and related upstream branding belong to BMad Code, LLC. The upstream MIT software license does not grant rights to that brand identity. FlowKit uses its own name and branding and makes no affiliation or endorsement claim.

Read the full official guidelines at the audited revision: https://github.com/bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD/blob/61e01f82644c4bb533750cfa0d6d61ab61d2cc9b/TRADEMARK.md.

This local pointer keeps the trademark reference in the unmodified upstream LICENSE usable; it does not replace or relicense the upstream policy.
